newsitem.title: USA: Voice Powered Technology names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Voice Powered Technology names new CEO.

text.p: Voice Powered Technology International Inc on Wednesday said it has named Mitchell Rubin president and chief executive officer, replacing Edward Krakauer.
Krakauer will continue as chairman of the board of directors and a consultant to Voice Powered Technology.
Rubin joined the company in January 1994 as vice president and general manager and was named chief financial officer and vice president finance and operations in December 1994.
"I am pleased that Mitch Rubin has accepted the position of president and CEO," Krakauer said in a statement.
